0022600001.text: Both the Boston Celtics and the Detroit Pistons open their 2026-27 seasons, with Boston visiting Detroit. Devin Carter is listed as day-to-day with an illness and is a game-time decision for the Celtics, while the Pistons have no players listed as unavailable. The Celtics lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 104-103 loss in Detroit on January 19, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Boston a 50% chance of winning.
